summary: Safely disenroll tenant from aggressive optimizer profile and verify baseline restore
description:
Issue summary:
Customer BrightPost Health reports a rapid increase in tail latency (95p/99p) and intermittent 5xxs after enrolling a subset of their tenants into an aggressive optimizer profile (prefetch + async batching + mixed-precision quantization). They request a safe, tenant-scoped unenrollment from the profile and validation that traffic returns to the previous baseline without adverse side-effects to other tenants.
impact: Several production endpoints for BrightPost Health show p95 latency increasing from ~120ms to ~420ms and a spike of 5xxs at ~3% for the last 45 minutes. Customer reports user-facing slowdowns in their chat workflow. This is a paying dedicated customer with strict latency SLAs.
environment_details: Dedicated pool: dp-ao-03, region: us-east, controller: v2.14.1, optimizer profile applied: opt_profile/aggressive-2026-03-v3. Traffic split: 100% of tenant traffic to optimized profile since 2026-03-10T08:03:00Z.
steps_to_reproduce:
1) Send baseline long-session prompts (8-12k tokens) to tenant's routing key.
2) Observe p95/p99 latency and error rates on per-tenant dashboard.
3) Toggle profile back to baseline snapshot (see runbook) and observe metrics change in 2-5 minutes.
actual_results: p95 latency 350-420ms, p99 up to 900ms, 5xx ~3% affecting long-session requests. Increased GPU memory churn and occasional OOM logs on nodes serving this tenant pool.
expected_results: Upon disenrollment, p95/p99 should return to pre-change baseline within 5-15 minutes and 5xxs should drop to <0.5% for tenant traffic. No cross-tenant regression expected.
logs:
Attached excerpts from pod logs and controller events: 
- serving-runtime: OOM eviction count increased from 0 to 6 on dp-ao-03 between 08:05-08:30Z
- scheduler: backpressure signals increase (queue_len spike)
- api-gateway: 502 responses correlated with nodes that show high kernel prefetch misses.
Links: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/tenant-brightpost/optimizer-telemetry?orgId=1&from=2026-03-10T07:50:00Z&to=2026-03-10T08:40:00Z
initial_customer_request: Can you unenroll only our tenant from 'aggressive-2026-03-v3' and confirm traffic is stable? We cannot accept global rollbacks. Please provide step-by-step guidance and expected SLO timeline.
support_notes: 2026-03-10 08:45 - Maya C: Created ticket, escalated to SRE and Runtime team.
2026-03-10 09:02 - Liam O: Acknowledged, starting investigation. Requested full per-tenant trace IDs and snapshot name.
2026-03-10 09:10 - Customer: Provided sample request IDs and confirmed no config changes on their side.
2026-03-10 09:28 - SRE: Observed correlated backpressure on dp-ao-03, memory churn concurrent with opt_profile application.
2026-03-10 09:40 - Runtime Eng: Noted PRs that modified prefetch eviction heuristics (see related_github_prs).
2026-03-10 10:05 - Liam O: Proposed tenant-scoped unenroll plan (snapshot restore + progressive traffic split).
investigation_notes: Hypothesis A: Aggressive KV prefetch combined with mixed quantization increased memory working set causing OOM eviction and higher tail latency for long sessions.
Hypothesis B: Asynchronous batching warmed up larger batch windows causing queuing spikes for long-context requests under this tenant's traffic distribution.
Telemetry: p95 token throughput dropped while queue lengths and retry counts increased. See grafana link in logs.
Correlated events: optimizer config push at 2026-03-10T08:03:00Z (opt_profile/aggressive-2026-03-v3). No infra autoscaler events triggered during the window.
Mitigations tried: temporary tenant-level rate limit reduction (10% throttle) to validate sensitivity; latency improved by ~18% under throttle but 5xx persisted.
runbook_action_items: 1) Take a config snapshot for tenant (snapshot id: tenant-brightpost-snap-20260310) using admin:configs snapshot --tenant brightpost --label before-unenroll
2) Validate snapshot integrity: admin:configs validate --snapshot tenant-brightpost-snap-20260310
3) Create isolation rule: route 100% of tenant traffic to a dedicated node group or mark for controlled split (if node isolation unavailable).
4) Apply tenant unenroll: admin:optimizer unenroll --tenant brightpost --profile aggressive-2026-03-v3 --target baseline-2026-02-27 --mode staged
5) Execute staged traffic split: 10% -> 50% -> 100% with 5 minute observation windows; rollback to previous step if p95 increases by >10% or 5xx >1%.
6) Monitor dashboards: tenant p95/p99, 5xx rate, GPU memory usage, kernel prefetch misses. Use Grafana link and the per-tenant console view.
7) If OOMs continue after unenroll, execute snapshot restore: admin:configs restore --snapshot tenant-brightpost-snap-20260310 --tenant brightpost and escalate to runtime team.
8) Post-restore validation and customer confirmation call; open postmortem if cross-tenant impact observed.
safety_checks: Confirm snapshot exists and validated prior to any unenroll step.
Ensure node-group capacity for dedicated routing is available; if not, coordinate with capacity team to provision small Burst pool.
Notify #incidents and #support channels and set incident bridge if transition begins during peak hours.
Set a kill-switch tag on the unenroll operation to abort and reapply snapshot quickly.
Preserve all logs and set retention to 30 days for the tenant's runtime pods for post-action analysis.
expected_timeline: Staged unenroll and first 10% observation: ~15 minutes. Full 100% unwind if no regressions: ~25-40 minutes. If snapshot restore required and data rehydration is needed, additional 20-40 minutes depending on node availability.
customer_communication_plan: Pre-action: Inform customer of exact timeline and monitoring links. During action: Provide updates at each traffic-step completion (10/50/100). Post-action: Confirmation that metrics are in baseline and summary of actions taken. Offer a follow-up call to review root cause and remediation options.

BrightPost Ops (Customer): Please proceed with staged unenroll. We will stand by to verify user-facing performance.
Liam O'Rourke: 2026-03-10 10:40 - 10% split completed. p95 reduced by 22%, 5xx dropped to 1.1%. Continuing to 50%.
Liam O'Rourke: 2026-03-10 10:55 - 50% split completed. p95 within 8% of baseline, 5xx 0.6%. Proceeding to 100% and close monitoring.
resolution_notes: 2026-03-10 11:10 - Completed staged unenroll to baseline-2026-02-27. Metrics stabilized: p95 ~125ms, p99 ~340ms, 5xx <0.4%.
Action taken: Tenant unenrolled from aggressive profile; snapshot preserved as tenant-brightpost-snap-20260310. No cross-tenant regressions detected.
Follow-up: Runtime team to add a conservative prefetch cap to aggressive profiles and add a guard that prevents enrolling long-session tenants without traffic shape validation.
Customer confirmed perceived performance restored and asked for a postmortem with recommended guardrails.
post_action_followups: Create a runtime guard that disallows opt_profile/aggressive-* from being applied to tenants with >25% long-session traffic without explicit override.
Add telemetry alert that triggers when tenant OOMs or kernel prefetch misses increase by >200% after profile change.
Schedule 1:1 with BrightPost Health to review results and timelines for a safer re-test of optimizer features.
